title: Sobornoe ulozhenie 1649 goda (Russian Wikisource transcription)
notes: The single text is a transcription on Russian Wikisource of the 1649 Sobornoe ulozhenie (Muscovite law code, Introduction and 25 chapters). It follows the Polnoe sobranie zakonov Rossiiskoi imperii, Sobranie pervoe, vol. I (St Petersburg, 1830), proofread page by page on Russian Wikisource; the text is public domain (RusGov licence template). No scholarly project stands behind it; it is a community wiki transcription rather than a TEI project. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
